info.name: TVK OTT Mobile and TV API
info.description: Implemented repository contract for Android, iOS, and TV integration. Supported requests only. See TVK_Mobile_API_Handoff.md for gaps and staging requirements. Configure baseUrl and an authorized user token. No admin credentials, production secrets or placeholder endpoints are included.

request.description: Public theme, branding, and feature toggles.
Required: phone (10 digits). Use an authorized test phone. This request can send an SMS.
Use a stable installation deviceId. Store token, refreshToken and user.id. A successful login at the plan limit clears older sessions.

Returns the authenticated user profile.

Required: language. Use the language code.
